sources.title: Zilean Ω - OTP In-Depth Zilean Guide 2026 updated May

passive.name: Time In A Bottle
passive.text: Zilean stores time as Experience and can grant it to his allies. When he has enough Experience to finish an ally's level up, he can right-click them to impart it. Zilean receives as much Experience as he gives.

spells.name: Time Bomb
spells.text: Tosses a bomb to target area that sticks to units that come near it (prioritizes Champions). It detonates after 3 seconds, dealing area of effect damage. If a Time Bomb is detonated early by another Time Bomb, it also stuns enemies.

spells.name: Rewind
spells.text: Zilean can prepare himself for future confrontations, reducing the cooldowns of his other basic abilities.

spells.name: Time Warp
spells.text: Zilean bends time around any unit, decreasing an enemy's Move Speed or increasing an ally's Move Speed for a short time.

spells.name: Chronoshift
spells.text: Zilean places a protective time rune on an allied champion, teleporting the champion back in time if they take lethal damage.

archetype.value: Zilean is a utility-focused support who helps teammates with speed, stuns, and revival.

winCondition.value: Zilean wins by enabling teammates to make big plays, even when he gets no credit for them.

spikes.at: When Chronoshift’s cooldown falls to 60 seconds
spikes.why: Zilean can offer its lethal-damage protection more often.

mistakes.value: Zilean players risk their lives by face-checking bushes instead of scouting with Time Bomb.
